title: सूरज के नीचे गायब हुआ हरा पेड़
topic: एक अनोखा पेड़ जो दोपहर की धूप में अचानक गायब हो जाता है और नन्हे चिंटू की जादुई खोज।
description: दोपहर के ठीक बारह बजे गाँव के बीचों-बीच खड़ा हरा-भरा पेड़ अचानक आँखों से ओझल हो जाता है! नन्हे चिंटू ने यह रहस्य देखा तो उसने तुरंत सच्चाई का पता लगाने की ठान ली। क्या है इस जादुई पेड़ का राज़? जानने के लिए देखिए पूरी कहानी। #KahaniPatang #KidsStories #MagicTree #HindiKahani #ChintuStories

characters.Chintu: English character sheet: age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सोचिए... आप एक पेड़ के नीचे खेल रहे हों, और ठीक बारह बजे वह अचानक गायब हो जाए!
scenes.style: warm, gentle storyteller, raising eyebrows in curiosity
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, standing under a large green banyan tree in a village square at noon, bright sunlight, wide shot, cinematic lighting.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्या यह कोई जादू था, या फिर आँखों का धोखा? आइए खुद देखते हैं!
scenes.style: excited, gripping tone, leaning closer to the microphone
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, looking up with a confused expression at the empty space where the tree stood, dusty village ground, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: नन्हे चिंटू ने अपनी आँखों पर यकीन नहीं किया। वह रोज़ इसी बरगद के नीचे खेलता था।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, rubbing his eyes in disbelief, standing on dusty village path, bright daylight, medium close-up.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अभी तो वह घनी छांव दे रहा था, और अब... वहाँ सिर्फ खाली धूप थी!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, pointing a finger at the bright sunny empty space, village background, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्या आप कभी ऐसी किसी चीज़ से मिले हैं जो पलक झपकते गायब हो जाए?
scenes.style: engaging, speaking directly to the audience, questioning
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, looking directly towards the camera with an inquisitive expression, village courtyard, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू ने हिम्मत जुटाई और उस खाली जगह की तरफ बढ़ा। ज़मीन पर कुछ चमक रहा था।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, walking cautiously towards a glowing spot on the dusty ground, sunny day, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अरे! यह तो एक सुनहरी पत्ती थी, जो तेज़ धूप में किसी तारे की तरह चमक रही थी।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, bending down to pick up a glowing golden leaf from the ground, bright sunlight, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: जैसे ही चिंटू ने उस पत्ती को छुआ, हवा में एक हल्की सी घंटी बजी—टन... टन...
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, holding the glowing leaf as tiny sparkling dust rises around his hands, magical atmosphere, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अब ध्यान से सुनिए... ज़मीन के नीचे से किसी के फुसफुसाने की आवाज़ आई!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, placing his ear near the ground with a serious listening face, village square, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आवाज़ बोली—'बाहर बहुत गर्मी है, इसलिए मैं दोपहर में आराम करने नीचे आ जाता हूँ!'
scenes.style: deep, friendly, slightly muffled voice acting
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, looking down at a small crack in the dry soil with wide amazed eyes, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चौंक गए ना? पेड़ कोई जादू से गायब नहीं हुआ था, वह धूप से बचने ज़मीन के नीचे खिसक जाता था!
scenes.style: cheerful, smiling tone, explaining the twist
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, smiling broadly and laughing while holding the golden leaf, sunny village day, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू ने मुस्कुराकर कहा—'चिंता मत करो दोस्त, कल से मैं तुम्हारे लिए छाता लेकर आऊँगा!'
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: Chintu, age 6, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look, waving happily towards the ground where the golden leaf glowed softly, peaceful village setting, wide shot.
